summary: KonaTel, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose receipt of an FCC notice regarding alleged Lifeline program rule violations at IM Telecom, a 51%-owned subsidiary. KonaTel owns 51% of IM Telecom after a 2024 transaction with Excess Telecom, which holds 49%; the original plan to sell the remaining 51% was contingent on FCC approval. IM Telecom disputes the allegations and will respond. The filing includes the related notice as an exhibit. This is a regulatory/legal event, not a typical special situation. Watch for FCC enforcement actions or potential impacts on the Excess Telecom stake and future subsidiary ownership.
